stand_in.command: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --exclude pourpoint-python && cargo check -p pourpoint-python
uv run --project crates/python --only-group docs mkdocs build --strict

environment_hazards: GDAL must be installed and discoverable via gdal-config; crates/gdal and the wheel build fail without it.

cargo build --workspace fails at link time on macOS because pourpoint-python is a pyo3 cdylib that resolves CPython symbols only under maturin's extension-module configuration; the build and test gates exclude pourpoint-python for this reason.
gate_orderings: The lint gate omits --all-targets deliberately. cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets is red on pre-existing test code (crates/core/tests/object_store_integration.rs, clippy::enum_variant_names) and CI does not lint test targets.
